papers.title_en: Realizing Logical Diagonal Gates via Transversal Physical $Z$-Rotations in CSS Codes
papers.authors: K. Sai Mineesh Reddy, Navin Kashyap
papers.evidence: 刻画CSS稳定子码的横向对角门实现条件
papers.tldr: CSS码通常为码参数优化，但其容错逻辑门能力受限。本文刻画嵌套经典码对与可实现逻辑对角门的关系，并提出“追加构造”：向输入CSS码追加物理比特，使扩展码通过横向物理Z旋转实现目标逻辑Z旋转。该构造保留原码的横向门，最小距离损失可控，且可重复扩展以支持多个目标门。显式构造了可寻址单比特Z旋转的CSS码族，为容错量子计算提供新途径。
papers.abstract_en: Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes, constructed from nested classical codes $C_2 \subseteq C_1$, are typically optimized for good code parameters. However, practical quantum computing equally demands fault-tolerant logical gates. In this work, we characterize nested pairs $(C_1, C_2)$ whose resulting CSS codes realize a target logical diagonal gate via transversal physical $Z$-rotations. In doing so, we recover a result of Camps-Moreno et al. that CSS codes can realize only logical single-qubit $Z$-rotations and multi-qubit controlled-$Z$ rotations via transversal physical $Z$-rotations. Building on our characterization, we develop the ''appending construction'', that takes as input an $[[n',k']]$ CSS code $Q'$ and a target logical $Z$-rotation (single-qubit or multi-controlled) $U_L$, and extends $Q'$ by systematically appending $n''$ physical qubits to obtain an $[[n,k]]$ CSS code $Q$ with $n = n'+n''$ and $k=k'$. The target logical gate $U_L$ is realized in $Q$ by applying a well-chosen physical transversal $Z$-rotation to the $n''$ appended physical qubits. Moreover, any logical gate realized via transversal physical $Z$-rotations in the input code $Q'$ remains transversally realizable in the extended code $Q$. The CSS code $Q$ may incur a loss in minimum distance, but the loss can be controlled through the parameter choices made in the construction. By repeatedly applying the appending construction, we can extend any CSS code $Q'$ to obtain a CSS code $Q$ that supports fault-tolerant implementations of multiple desired logical $Z$-rotations. The cost to be paid for this is the increased physical qubit overhead as the number of target logical gates grows. We illustrate our methodology by providing explicit constructions of CSS code families that transversally realize addressable logical single-qubit $Z$-rotations.

papers.title_en: A Classification of Translation-Invariant Quantum Codes in Any Dimension
papers.evidence: 拓扑量子纠错研究进展，平移不变量子码分类
papers.tldr: 量子纠错码的分类是量子信息中的重要问题。已知二维平移不变码等价于二维环面码的副本，但更高维情形因存在多种环面码和分形码而复杂。本文聚焦于基于长度D链复形的D维平移不变量子码，包括变量数等于循环数的多变量多循环码。作者证明此类码等价于D维环面码的副本，将二维分类结果直接推广到任意维度，为高维量子码的结构理解提供了关键进展。
papers.abstract_en: Quantum error-correcting codes with two-dimensional translation invariance are known to be equivalent to copies of the two-dimensional toric code. Such a simple classification is not possible for quantum codes with higher dimensional translation invariance due to the existence of multiple types of toric codes and infinite families of fracton codes. Here, we focus on D-dimensional translation-invariant quantum codes based on length-D chain complexes. This includes multivariate multicycle codes where the number of variables equals the number of cycles. We show that such codes are equivalent to copies of D-dimensional toric codes. This directly generalizes the classification result for two-dimensional translation-invariant codes.
